head: codex/298-anchored-classification-recovery
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Add anchored projection classification and recovery
body:
## Summary

- add read-only anchored projection classification with exact candidate and attempt inventory
- retain descriptor authority through recovery receipts, inventory, candidate construction, archive, displacement, and publication mutations
- add immutable recovery and per-node receipt ledgers with deterministic restart across exchange and non-exchange anchors
- enforce portable fail-closed mount identity on macOS and Linux, including explicit STATX_MNT_ID authority
- preserve current main initialized recovery journal behavior after resolving the PR #305 store.rs merge conflict

## Validation

- governed focused recovery lane: 37 passed, 19 filtered
- governed csdlc-v2 library suite: 78 passed
- governed strict all-target Clippy: passed
- cargo fmt --check: passed
- git diff --check: passed
- independent exact-revision review R26: PASS, no actionable findings

R26 review is bound to scoped revision git-blake3:222abd504d99a3bedc224699c0b68d302aac25b7:84e0aadc005c93ddf4bf88ac30533059fc92a2038fae8d23f727d44885c3e4fd. Publication head 41a64d3c94972a5f305f9271ea847146b018204f adds only typed review metadata after that reviewed source tree. Hosted CI is required after republication before terminal finish. No dynamic cross-mount injection is claimed.

Closes #298
